design: Very old tall Yautja archivist with pronounced brow ridges, narrow weathered mandibles and sparse shoulder-length grey dreadlocks. Long dark high-collar robe with a straight silver embroidered front strip, layered short shoulder cape, rectangular tablet holder at the waist. Left hand leans lightly on a plain archival walking staff with a closed ring head, right hand examines a hinged slate. Stooped dignified posture, ash-grey scales.
